release_title: CEF 8078 (Chromium 156) Linux x86_64, built by obs-rust (binary, not a source release)

source.upstream_note: The Linux recipe tracks the moving upstream branch (--branch=8078, no --checkout); this commit is read from the CEF_VERSION string inside the archive, not from the recipe.

patch_note: No recipe applies a patch from any branch of this repository. The fork's OBS-specific patches are therefore not in these archives; whether that is correct for obs-browser is open on obs-rust/obs-studio#2674.

build.codesign: Not signed at all: the framework, its inner binary, libcef_sandbox.dylib and both libcef_dll_wrapper.a report 'code object is not signed at all'. That asymmetry is the toolchain (ld64 ad-hoc signs arm64 output because Apple silicon requires it, and imposes no such requirement on x86_64), not a skipped signing step.

gaps: The Linux recipe pins a branch, not a commit: the built revision is known only from the CEF_VERSION string inside the archive.

The macOS x86_64 log's CEF_ENABLE_AMD64=1 and GN_OUT_CONFIGS=Release_GN_x64 exports only exist in the recipe at 5d80772 (#18), which merged after both archives were packed; the run used pre-merge script content.
The macOS archives carry symbol_level=1 but no dSYM (the directory was removed before packing), so line tables are present in the binaries and there are no separate debug-symbol archives.
No source tarball (cef.tar.gz) is attached to this release.
The macOS archives are pinned by hash, not by an attested build run; the builder's identity was validated by the maintainer on the OBS Rust Discord (obs-rust/obs-studio#2418).
